## Wilms Tumor Dataset

```{r,include=F}
setwd("Path to folder on computer where you saved the dataset")
```

```{r}
#Read in dataset and look at first few rows
wilms=read.csv("wilms.csv")
head(wilms)
library(visdat)
vis_miss(wilms)
```

## Descriptive Statistics

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
wilms$ones=rep(1,dim(wilms)[1])
g=ggplot(wilms)+geom_bar(stat="identity",aes(x=as.factor(stage),y=ones,fill=as.factor(rel)),position = "fill")
g=g+theme_classic()
g=g+scale_fill_manual(values = c("navy","dodgerblue"),labels=c("No","Yes"))
g=g+xlab("Tumor Stage")+ylab("Proportion")
g=g+theme(text=element_text(size=20),legend.position="top")
g=g+guides(fill=guide_legend(title="Relapse"))
g
```

```{r}
g=ggplot(wilms)+geom_bar(stat="identity",aes(x=histol,y=ones,fill=as.factor(rel)),position = "fill")
g=g+theme_classic()
g=g+scale_fill_manual(values = c("navy","dodgerblue"),labels=c("No","Yes"))
g=g+xlab("Histology")+ylab("Proportion")
g=g+scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(1,2),labels=c("Favorable","Unfavorable"))
g=g+theme(text=element_text(size=20),legend.position="top")
g=g+guides(fill=guide_legend(title="Relapse"))
g
```

```{r}
wilms$age_dec=cut(wilms$age,10,labels=1:10)
g=ggplot(wilms)+geom_bar(stat="identity",aes(x=age_dec,y=ones,fill=as.factor(rel)),position = "fill")
g=g+theme_classic()
g=g+scale_fill_manual(values = c("navy","dodgerblue"),labels=c("No","Yes"))
g=g+xlab("Age Decile")+ylab("Proportion")
g=g+theme(text=element_text(size=20),legend.position="top")
g=g+guides(fill=guide_legend(title="Relapse"))
g
```


## Statistical Modeling and Inference

$$\textrm{Log-Odds of Relapse}=\beta_0+\beta_1\textrm{Age}+\beta_2\textrm{Tumor Stage}+\beta_3\textrm{Unfavorable Histology}$$
```{r}
#Logistic Regression Model
regression=glm(rel~age+stage+histol,data=wilms,family="binomial")
summary(regression)
```

## Prediction

```{r}
#Predicted Relapse Probability for Specific Patients
newdata=data.frame(age=c(10,15,20),stage=c(1,3,4),histol=c(1,0,1))
newdata$phat=predict(regression,newdata=newdata,type="response")
names(newdata)=c("age","stage","histol","predicted relapse probability")
newdata
```


```{r, message=F}
#ROC Curve for Prediction Model
library(WVPlots)
wilms$phat=predict(regression,newdata=wilms,type="response")
ROCPlot(wilms, xvar="phat", truthVar = "rel", truthTarget=1, title="ROC Curve for Relapse")
```

```{r, message=F}
#Calibration Plot
library(CalibrationCurves)
val.prob.ci.2(wilms$phat,wilms$rel,dostats=F)
```
